$comment: Vcpkg manifest for the Windows MSVC CI build. Linux uses pkg-config + apt; only consumed when CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE points at vcpkg.cmake (i.e. in the windows-build-test job).
name: kartend
$comment-baseline: Kartend-szdbl: pins the vcpkg port snapshot so sdl2/zstd versions don't float with whatever windows-latest ships that week (non-reproducible release builds). Advance deliberately: update to a newer microsoft/vcpkg commit SHA and rebuild the Windows leg. bump-version.sh keeps version-string in sync with VERSION; release.yml enforces it.
description: Optional native deps for the Windows MSVC build (SDL2 gamepad backend, zstd for kart compression). Qt6 and Qt6Keychain are NOT here: Qt6 comes from jurplel/install-qt-action which serves the official binaries faster than vcpkg can build from source, and Qt6Keychain has no vcpkg port that plays nicely with install-qt-action's Qt; the scraper credential layer falls back to plaintext-INI when QtKeychain isn't found (same as Linux without qtkeychain-qt6-dev).
